item.title: Trump slaps 500pc tariffs on India, China

item.title: BD further restricts visa for Indians
item.description: Bangladesh has further restricted visa issuance for Indian nationals, extending the curbs to its deputy high commissions in Kolkata, Mumbai and Chennai.The Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed the decision on Wednesday night, saying the restrictions have come into effect from Thursday. item.title: 174 more file appeals with EC on 4th day
item.description: A total of 174 new appeals were submitted to the Election Commission (EC) on Thursday (Jan 8), the fourth day of appeals against returning officers' decisions on nomination papers for the 13th National Parliamentary Election. With these, the total number of appeals received so far has reached 469, the EC reported in the evening.According to the election schedule, the appeal submission period will continue until January 9, while hearings will be held from January 10 to 18.
